caseName: Harrison v. Local 54, American Federation of State, County & Municipal Employees
caseNameFull: Harrison v. Local 54, American Federation of State, County & Municipal Employees, AFL-CIO

opinions.text: Appeal from C. A. 3d Cir. dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, cer-tiorari denied.
